Bandingkan eksperimen ini dengan eksperimen sebelumnya, dan perhatikan kesamaannya, hingga perubahan skalanya.

payload.source_text: The Matching Distribution
payload.target_text: Distribusi Pencocokan

payload.source_text: For \(n \in \N_+\), consider a random permutation \((X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n)\) of the elements in the set \(\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\). We say that a match occurs at position \(i\) if \(X_i = i\).
payload.target_text: Untuk \(n \in \N_+\), tinjau permutasi acak \((X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n)\) dari elemen-elemen himpunan \(\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\). Kita mengatakan bahwa suatu kecocokan terjadi pada posisi \(i\) jika \(X_i = i\).

payload.source_text: \(\P\left(X_i = i\right) = \frac{1}{n}\) for each \(i \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\).
payload.target_text: \(\P\left(X_i = i\right) = \frac{1}{n}\) untuk setiap \(i \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text: The number of permutations of \(\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) is \(n!\). For \(i \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\), the number of such permutations with \(i\) in position \(i\) is \((n - 1)!\). Hence \(\P(X_i = i) = (n - 1)! / n! = 1 / n\). A more direct argument is that \(i\) is no more or less likely to end up in position \(i\) as any other number.
payload.target_text: Banyaknya permutasi dari \(\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) adalah \(n!\). Untuk \(i \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\), banyaknya permutasi dengan \(i\) pada posisi \(i\) adalah \((n - 1)!\). Oleh karena itu, \(\P(X_i = i) = (n - 1)! / n! = 1 / n\). Argumen yang lebih langsung adalah bahwa \(i\) tidak lebih atau kurang mungkin menempati posisi \(i\) dibandingkan bilangan lainnya.

payload.source_text: So the matching events all have the same probability, which varies inversely with the number of trials.
payload.target_text: Jadi, semua kejadian kecocokan mempunyai probabilitas yang sama, yang berbanding terbalik dengan banyaknya percobaan.

payload.source_text: \(\P\left(X_i = i, X_j = j\right) = \frac{1}{n (n - 1)}\) for \(i, \, j \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) with \(i \ne j\).
payload.target_text: \(\P\left(X_i = i, X_j = j\right) = \frac{1}{n (n - 1)}\) untuk \(i, \, j \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) dengan \(i \ne j\).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text: Again, the number of permutations of \(\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) is \(n!\). For distinct \(i, \, j \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\), the number of such permutations with \(i\) in position \(i\) and \(j\) in position \(j\) is \((n - 2)!\). Hence \(\P(X_i = i, X_j = j) = (n - 2)! / n! = 1 / n (n - 1)\).
payload.target_text: Sekali lagi, banyaknya permutasi dari \(\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) adalah \(n!\). Untuk \(i, \, j \in \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) yang berbeda, banyaknya permutasi dengan \(i\) pada posisi \(i\) dan \(j\) pada posisi \(j\) adalah \((n - 2)!\). Oleh karena itu, \(\P(X_i = i, X_j = j) = (n - 2)! / n! = 1 / n (n - 1)\).

payload.source_text:
So the matching events are dependent, and in fact are positively correlated. In particular, the matching events do not form a sequence of Bernoulli trials. In our detailed disucssion of the matching problem we show that the number of matches \(N_n\) has probability density function \(f_n\) given by:
\[ f_n(k) = \frac{1}{k!} \sum_{j=0}^{n-k} \frac{(-1)^j}{j!}, \quad k \in \{0, 1, \ldots, n\} \]
payload.target_text:
Jadi, kejadian-kejadian kecocokan saling bergantung dan bahkan berkorelasi positif. Secara khusus, kejadian-kejadian tersebut tidak membentuk barisan percobaan Bernoulli. Dalam pembahasan terperinci tentang masalah pencocokan , kita menunjukkan bahwa banyaknya kecocokan \(N_n\) mempunyai fungsi kepadatan probabilitas \(f_n\) yang diberikan oleh:
\[ f_n(k) = \frac{1}{k!} \sum_{j=0}^{n-k} \frac{(-1)^j}{j!}, \quad k \in \{0, 1, \ldots, n\} \]

payload.source_text: The distribution of \(N_n\) converges to the Poisson distribution with parameter 1 as \(n \to \infty\).
payload.target_text: Distribusi \(N_n\) konvergen ke distribusi Poisson dengan parameter 1 saat \(n \to \infty\).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text:
For \( k \in \N \),
		\[ f_n(k) = \frac{1}{k!} \sum_{j=0}^{n-k} \frac{(-1)^j}{j!} \to \frac{1}{k!} \sum_{j=0}^\infty \frac{(-1)^j}{j!} = \frac{1}{k!} e^{-1} \]
		As a function of \(k \in \N\), this is the density function of the Poisson distribution with parameter 1. So the result follows from the theorem in on density functions.
payload.target_text:
Untuk \( k \in \N \),
		\[ f_n(k) = \frac{1}{k!} \sum_{j=0}^{n-k} \frac{(-1)^j}{j!} \to \frac{1}{k!} \sum_{j=0}^\infty \frac{(-1)^j}{j!} = \frac{1}{k!} e^{-1} \]
		Sebagai fungsi dari \(k \in \N\), ini adalah fungsi kepadatan dari distribusi Poisson dengan parameter 1. Jadi hasilnya mengikuti teorema di pada fungsi kepadatan.

payload.source_text: In the matching experiment , increase \(n\) and note the apparent convergence of the probability density function for the number of matches.  With selected values of \(n\), run the experiment 1000 times and compare the relative frequency function and the probability density function.
payload.target_text: Dalam eksperimen pencocokan , naikkan \(n\) dan perhatikan konvergensi yang tampak pada fungsi kepadatan probabilitas untuk banyaknya kecocokan.  Untuk beberapa nilai \(n\), jalankan eksperimen 1000 kali lalu bandingkan fungsi frekuensi relatif dengan fungsi kepadatan probabilitas.

payload.source_text: The Extreme Value Distribution
payload.target_text: Distribusi Nilai Ekstrem

payload.source_text:
Suppose that \((X_1, X_2, \ldots)\) is a sequence of independent random variables, each with the standard exponential distribution . So the common distribution function \(G\) is given by
\[ G(x) = 1 - e^{-x}, \quad 0 \le x \lt \infty \]
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \((X_1, X_2, \ldots)\) adalah barisan peubah acak bebas yang masing-masing mempunyai distribusi eksponensial standar. Jadi, fungsi distribusi bersama \(G\) diberikan oleh
\[ G(x) = 1 - e^{-x}, \quad 0 \le x \lt \infty \]

payload.source_text:
As \(n \to \infty\), the distribution of \(Y_n = \max\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} - \ln n  \) converges to the distribution with distribution function \(F\) given by
	\[ F(x) = e^{-e^{-x}}, \quad x \in \R\]
payload.target_text:
Sebagai \(n \to \infty\), distribusi \(Y_n = \max\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} - \ln n  \) konvergen ke distribusi dengan fungsi distribusi \(F\) diberikan oleh
	\[ F(x) = e^{-e^{-x}}, \quad x \in \R\]

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text:
Let \( X_{(n)} = \max\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} \) and recall that \( X_{(n)} \) has distribution function \( G^n \). Let \( F_n \) denote the distribution function of \( Y_n \). For \( x \in \R \)
		\[ F_n(x) = \P(Y_n \le x) = \P\left(X_{(n)} \le x + \ln n \right) = G^n(x + \ln n) = \left[1 - e^{-(x + \ln n) }\right]^n = \left(1 - \frac{e^{-x}}{n} \right)^n \]
		By our famous limit from calculus again, \( F_n(x) \to e^{-e^{-x}} \) as \( n \to \infty \).
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \( X_{(n)} = \max\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} \) dan ingat bahwa \( X_{(n)} \) mempunyai fungsi distribusi \( G^n \). Misalkan \( F_n \) menunjukkan fungsi distribusi dari \( Y_n \). Untuk \( x \in \R \)
		\[ F_n(x) = \P(Y_n \le x) = \P\left(X_{(n)} \le x + \ln n \right) = G^n(x + \ln n) = \left[1 - e^{-(x + \ln n) }\right]^n = \left(1 - \frac{e^{-x}}{n} \right)^n \]
		Dengan batasan kita yang terkenal dari kalkulus lagi, \( F_n(x) \to e^{-e^{-x}} \) saat \( n \to \infty \).

payload.source_text: This limiting distribution is the standard extreme value distribution , also known as the standard Gumbel distribution in honor of Emil Gumbel .
payload.target_text: Distribusi limit ini adalah distribusi nilai ekstrem standar, yang juga dikenal sebagai distribusi Gumbel standar untuk menghormati Emil Gumbel .

payload.source_text: The Pareto Distribution
payload.target_text: Distribusi Pareto

payload.source_text:
Recall that the Pareto distribution with shape parameter \(a \in (0, \infty)\) has distribution function \(F\) given by
\[F(x) = 1 - \frac{1}{x^a}, \quad 1 \le x \lt \infty\]
The Pareto distribution, named for Vilfredo Pareto , is a heavy-tailed distribution sometimes used to model financial variables.
payload.target_text:
Ingat bahwa distribusi Pareto dengan parameter bentuk \(a \in (0, \infty)\) mempunyai fungsi distribusi \(F\) yang diberikan oleh
\[F(x) = 1 - \frac{1}{x^a}, \quad 1 \le x \lt \infty\]
Distribusi Pareto, yang dinamai menurut Vilfredo Pareto , adalah distribusi berekor berat yang kadang digunakan untuk memodelkan peubah keuangan.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(X_n\) has the Pareto distribution with parameter \(n\) for each \(n \in \N_+\). Then
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(X_n\) memiliki distribusi Pareto dengan parameter \(n\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+\). Maka

payload.source_text: \(X_n \to 1\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution (and hence also in probability).
payload.target_text: \(X_n \to 1\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi (dan karenanya juga dalam probabilitas).

payload.source_text: The distribution of \(Y_n = nX_n - n\) converges to the standard exponential distribution as \(n \to \infty\).
payload.target_text: Distribusi \(Y_n = nX_n - n\) konvergen ke distribusi eksponensial standar saat \(n \to \infty\).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text: The distribution function of \( X_n \) is \( F_n(x) = 1 - 1 / x^n \) for \( x \ge 1 \). Hence \( F_n(x) = 0 \) for \( n \in \N_+ \) and \( x \le 1 \) while \( F_n(x) \to 1 \) as \( n \to \infty \) for \( x \gt 1 \). Thus the limit of \( F_n \) agrees with the distribution function of the constant 1, except at \(x = 1\), the point of discontinuity.
payload.target_text: Fungsi distribusi dari \( X_n \) adalah \( F_n(x) = 1 - 1 / x^n \) untuk \( x \ge 1 \). Oleh karena itu \( F_n(x) = 0 \) untuk \( n \in \N_+ \) dan \( x \le 1 \) sementara \( F_n(x) \to 1 \) saat \( n \to \infty \) untuk \( x \gt 1 \). Jadi batasnya \( F_n \) setuju dengan fungsi distribusi konstanta 1, kecuali pada \(x = 1\), titik diskontinuitas.

payload.source_text:
Let \( G_n \) denote the distribution function of \( Y_n \). For \( x \ge 0 \),
			\[ G_n(x) = \P(Y_n \le x) = \P(X_n \le 1 + x / n) = 1 - \frac{1}{(1 + x / n)^n} \]
			By our famous theorem from calculus again, it follows that \( G_n(x) \to 1 - 1 / e^x = 1 - e^{-x} \) as \( n \to \infty \). As a function of \(x \in [0, \infty\), this is the distribution function of the standard exponential distribution.
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \( G_n \) menunjukkan fungsi distribusi dari \( Y_n \). Untuk \( x \ge 0 \),
			\[ G_n(x) = \P(Y_n \le x) = \P(X_n \le 1 + x / n) = 1 - \frac{1}{(1 + x / n)^n} \]
			Sekali lagi, dengan teorema terkenal kita dari kalkulus, berikut ini \( G_n(x) \to 1 - 1 / e^x = 1 - e^{-x} \) saat \( n \to \infty \). Sebagai fungsi dari \(x \in [0, \infty\), ini adalah fungsi distribusi dari distribusi eksponensial standar.

payload.source_text: Fundamental Theorems
payload.target_text: Teorema Dasar

payload.source_text: The two fundamental theorems of basic probability theory, the law of large numbers and the central limit theorem are studied in detail in the chapter on random samples . For this reason we will simply state the results in this section. So suppose that \((X_1, X_2, \ldots)\) is a sequence of independent, identically distributed, real-valued random variables (defined on the same probability space) with mean \(\mu \in (-\infty. \infty)\) and standard deviation \(\sigma \in (0, \infty)\). For \(n \in \N_+\), let \( Y_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i \) denote the sum of the first \(n\) variables, \( M_n = Y_n \big/n  \) the average of the first \( n \) variables, and \( Z_n = (Y_n - n \mu) \big/ \sqrt{n} \sigma \) the standard score of \( Y_n \).
payload.target_text: Dua teorema dasar dalam teori probabilitas, yaitu hukum bilangan besar dan teorema limit pusat , dipelajari secara terperinci dalam bab tentang sampel acak . Karena itu, pada bagian ini kita hanya akan menyatakan hasilnya. Misalkan \((X_1, X_2, \ldots)\) adalah barisan peubah acak bernilai real yang bebas dan berdistribusi identik (didefinisikan pada ruang probabilitas yang sama), dengan rataan \(\mu \in (-\infty. \infty)\) dan simpangan baku \(\sigma \in (0, \infty)\). Untuk \(n \in \N_+\), misalkan \( Y_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i \) menyatakan jumlah \(n\) peubah pertama, \( M_n = Y_n \big/n  \) menyatakan rata-rata \( n \) peubah pertama, dan \( Z_n = (Y_n - n \mu) \big/ \sqrt{n} \sigma \) menyatakan skor baku dari \( Y_n \).

payload.source_text: The fundamental theorems of probability
payload.target_text: Teorema dasar probabilitas

payload.source_text: \( M_n \to \mu \) as \( n \to \infty \) with probability 1 (and hence also in probability and in distribution). This is the law of large numbers .
payload.target_text: \( M_n \to \mu \) saat \( n \to \infty \) dengan probabilitas 1 (dan karenanya juga dalam probabilitas dan distribusi). Ini adalah hukum bilangan besar .

payload.source_text: The distribution of \( Z_n \) converges to the standard normal distribution as \( n \to \infty \). This is the central limit theorem .
payload.target_text: Distribusi \( Z_n \) konvergen ke distribusi normal standar saat \( n \to \infty \). Ini adalah teorema limit pusat .

payload.source_text: In part (a), convergence with probability 1 is the strong law of large numbers while convergence in probability and in distribution are the weak laws of large numbers .
payload.target_text: Pada bagian (a), konvergensi dengan probabilitas 1 disebut hukum kuat bilangan besar , sedangkan konvergensi dalam probabilitas dan dalam distribusi disebut hukum lemah bilangan besar .

payload.source_text: General Spaces
payload.target_text: Ruang Umum

payload.source_text: Our next goal is to define convergence of probability distributions on more general measurable spaces .
payload.target_text: Tujuan kita selanjutnya adalah mendefinisikan konvergensi distribusi probabilitas pada ruang terukur yang lebih umum.

payload.source_text: Definition and Basic Properties
payload.target_text: Definisi dan Sifat Dasar

payload.source_text: First we need to define the type of measurable spaces that we will use in this subsection.
payload.target_text: Pertama kita perlu menentukan jenis ruang terukur yang akan kita gunakan dalam subbagian ini.

payload.source_text: We assume that \((S, d)\) is a complete, separable metric space and let \(\ms S\) denote the Borel \(\sigma\)-algebra of subsets of \(S\), that is, the \(\sigma\)-algebra generated by the topology. The standard spaces that we often use are special cases:
payload.target_text: Kita mengasumsikan bahwa \((S, d)\) adalah ruang metrik lengkap dan separabel, serta \(\ms S\) menyatakan aljabar-\(\sigma\) Borel dari himpunan-himpunan bagian \(S\), yakni aljabar-\(\sigma\) yang dibangkitkan oleh topologi. Ruang-ruang baku yang sering kita gunakan merupakan kasus khusus:

payload.source_text: The space \((S, \ms S)\) is discrete if \(S\) is countable and is given the discrete metric so \(\ms S\) is the collection of all subsets of \(S\).
payload.target_text: Ruang \((S, \ms S)\) disebut diskret jika \(S\) terhitung dan dilengkapi dengan metrik diskret, sehingga \(\ms S\) merupakan koleksi semua himpunan bagian \(S\).

payload.source_text: For \(n \in \N_+\), the space \((\R^n, \ms R^n)\) is the \(n\)-dimensional Euclidean space , corresponding to  the standard Euclidean metric so \(\ms R^n\) is the usual \(\sigma\)-algebra of Borel measurable subsets of \(\R^n\).
payload.target_text: Untuk \(n \in \N_+\), ruang \((\R^n, \ms R^n)\) adalah ruang Euklides berdimensi \(n\), yang bersesuaian dengan metrik Euklides baku, sehingga \(\ms R^n\) merupakan aljabar-\(\sigma\) Borel biasa dari himpunan-himpunan bagian terukur \(\R^n\).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text: Recall that the metric space \((S, d)\) is complete if every Cauchy sequence in \(S\) converges to a point in \(S\). The space is separable if there exists a coutable subset that is dense. A complete, separable metric space is sometimes called a Polish space because such spaces were extensively studied by a group of Polish mathematicians in the 1930s, including Kazimierz Kuratowski .
payload.target_text: Ingat bahwa ruang metrik \((S, d)\) disebut lengkap jika setiap barisan Cauchy dalam \(S\) konvergen ke suatu titik di \(S\). Ruang tersebut disebut separabel jika mempunyai himpunan bagian terhitung yang padat. Ruang metrik lengkap dan separabel kadang-kadang disebut ruang Polish karena ruang semacam ini dipelajari secara luas oleh sekelompok matematikawan Polandia pada dekade 1930-an, termasuk Kazimierz Kuratowski .

payload.source_text: As suggested by our setup, the definition for convergence in distribution involves both measure theory and topology . The motivation is for the one-dimensional Euclidean space \((\R, \ms R)\).
payload.target_text: Seperti disiratkan oleh kerangka kita, definisi konvergensi dalam distribusi melibatkan teori ukuran sekaligus topologi . Motivasinya diberikan oleh untuk ruang Euklides satu dimensi \((\R, \ms R)\).

payload.source_text: Convergence in distribution :
payload.target_text: Konvergensi dalam distribusi :

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(P_n\) is a probability measure on \((S, \ms S)\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\). Then \(P_n\) converges (weakly) to \(P_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) if \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) as \(n \to \infty\) for every \(A \in \ms S\) with \(P_\infty(\partial A) = 0\). We write \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\).
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(P_n\) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada \((S, \ms S)\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\). Maka \(P_n\) konvergen (secara lemah) ke \(P_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) jika \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) untuk setiap \(A \in \ms S\) dengan \(P_\infty(\partial A) = 0\). Kita menulis \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\).

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(X_n\) is a random variable with distribution \(P_n\) on \((S, \ms S)\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\). Then \(X_n\) converges in distribution to \(X_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) if \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\). We write \(X_n \to X_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution.
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(X_n\) adalah peubah acak dengan distribusi \(P_n\) pada \((S, \ms S)\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\). Maka \(X_n\) konvergen dalam distribusi ke \(X_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) jika \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\). Kita menulis \(X_n \to X_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi.

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text: The definition makes sense since \(A \in \ms S\) implies \(\partial A \in \ms S\). Specifically, \(\cl(A) \in \ms S\) because \(\cl(A)\) is closed, and \(\interior(A) \in \ms S\) because \(\interior(A)\) is open.
payload.target_text: Definisi tersebut masuk akal karena \(A \in \ms S\) menyiratkan \(\partial A \in \ms S\). Secara khusus, \(\cl(A) \in \ms S\) karena \(\cl(A)\) tertutup, dan \(\interior(A) \in \ms S\) karena \(\interior(A)\) terbuka.

payload.source_text: The random variables need not be defined on the same probability space, since only their distributions are involved.
payload.target_text: Peubah acak tidak perlu didefinisikan pada ruang probabilitas yang sama, karena hanya distribusinya saja yang terlibat.

payload.source_text: Let's consider our two special cases. In the discrete case, as usual, the measure theory and topology are not really necessary.
payload.target_text: Mari kita pertimbangkan dua kasus khusus kita. Dalam kasus diskrit, seperti biasa, teori ukuran dan topologi tidak terlalu diperlukan.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(P_n\) is a probability measures on a discrete space \((S, \ms S)\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\). Then \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) if and only if \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) as \(n \to \infty\) for every \(A \subseteq S\).
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(P_n\) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada ruang diskrit \((S, \ms S)\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\). Maka \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) jika dan hanya jika \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) untuk setiap \(A \subseteq S\).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text: This follows from the definition. Every subset is both open and closed so \(\partial A = \emptyset\) for every \(A \subseteq S\).
payload.target_text: Hal ini langsung mengikuti definisi. Setiap himpunan bagian terbuka sekaligus tertutup, sehingga \(\partial A = \emptyset\) untuk setiap \(A \subseteq S\).

payload.source_text:
In the Euclidean case, it suffices to consider distribution functions, as in the one-dimensional case. If \(P\) is a probability measure on \((\R^n, \ms R^n)\), recall that the distribution function \(F\) of \(P\) is given by
\[F(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) = P\left((-\infty, x_1] \times (-\infty, x_2] \times \cdots \times (-\infty, x_n]\right), \quad (x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \in \R^n\]
payload.target_text:
Dalam kasus Euklides, cukup mempertimbangkan fungsi distribusi, seperti pada kasus satu dimensi. Jika \(P\) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada \((\R^n, \ms R^n)\), ingat bahwa fungsi distribusi \(F\) dari \(P\) diberikan oleh
\[F(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) = P\left((-\infty, x_1] \times (-\infty, x_2] \times \cdots \times (-\infty, x_n]\right), \quad (x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \in \R^n\]

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(P_n\) is a probability measures on \((\R^n, \ms R^n)\) with distribution function \(F_n\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\). Then \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) if and only if \(F_n(\bs x) \to F_\infty(\bs x)\) as \(n \to \infty\) for every \(\bs x \in \R^n\) where \(F_\infty\) is continuous.
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(P_n\) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada \((\R^n, \ms R^n)\) dengan fungsi distribusi \(F_n\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\). Maka \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) jika dan hanya jika \(F_n(\bs x) \to F_\infty(\bs x)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) untuk setiap \(\bs x \in \R^n\) tempat \(F_\infty\) kontinu.

payload.source_text: Convergence in Probability
payload.target_text: Konvergensi dalam Probabilitas

payload.source_text: As in the case of \((\R, \ms R)\), convergence in probability implies convergence in distribution.
payload.target_text: Seperti dalam kasus \((\R, \ms R)\), konvergensi dalam probabilitas menyiratkan konvergensi dalam distribusi.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(X_n\) is a random variable in \(S\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\), all defined on the same probability space. If \(X_n \to X_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) in probability then \(X_n \to X_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution.
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(X_n\) adalah peubah acak di \(S\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\), semuanya didefinisikan pada ruang probabilitas yang sama. Jika \(X_n \to X_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam probabilitas, maka \(X_n \to X_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi.

payload.source_text: Notes:
payload.target_text: Catatan:

payload.source_text: Assume that the common probability space is \((\Omega, \ms F, \P)\). Recall that convergence in probability means that \(\P[d(X_n, X_\infty) \gt \epsilon] \to 0\) as \(n \to \infty\) for every \(\epsilon \gt 0\),
payload.target_text: Asumsikan bahwa ruang probabilitas bersama adalah \((\Omega, \ms F, \P)\). Ingat bahwa konvergensi dalam probabilitas berarti \(\P[d(X_n, X_\infty) \gt \epsilon] \to 0\) saat \(n \to \infty\) untuk setiap \(\epsilon \gt 0\),

payload.source_text: So as before, convergence with probability 1 implies convergence in probability which in turn implies convergence in distribution.
payload.target_text: Jadi, seperti sebelumnya, konvergensi dengan probabilitas 1 mengakibatkan konvergensi dalam probabilitas, yang selanjutnya mengakibatkan konvergensi dalam distribusi.

payload.source_text: Skorohod's Representation Theorem
payload.target_text: Teorema Representasi Skorohod

payload.source_text: As you might guess, Skorohod's for the one-dimensional Euclidean space \((\R, \ms R)\) can be extended to the more general spaces. However the proof is not nearly as straightforward, because we no longer have the quantile function for constructing random variables on a common probability space.
payload.target_text: Seperti yang mungkin Anda duga, Skorohod untuk ruang Euklides satu dimensi \((\R, \ms R)\) dapat diperluas ke ruang yang lebih umum. Namun, pembuktiannya tidak sesederhana itu karena kita tidak lagi mempunyai fungsi kuantil untuk membangun peubah acak pada ruang probabilitas bersama.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(P_n\) is a probability measures on \((S, \ms S)\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\) and that \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\). Then there exists a random variable \(X_n\) in \(S\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\), defined on a common probability space, such that
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(P_n\) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada \((S, \ms S)\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\), dan \(P_n \Rightarrow P_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\). Maka terdapat peubah acak \(X_n\) di \(S\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\), semuanya didefinisikan pada ruang probabilitas yang sama, sedemikian sehingga

payload.source_text: \(X_n\) has distribution \(P_n\) for \(n \in \N_+^*\)
payload.target_text: \(X_n\) memiliki distribusi \(P_n\) untuk \(n \in \N_+^*\)

payload.source_text: \(X_n \to X_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) with probability 1.
payload.target_text: \(X_n \to X_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dengan probabilitas 1.

payload.source_text: One of the main consequences of Skorohod's representation, the preservation of convergence in distribution under continuous functions, is still true and has essentially the same proof. For the general setup, suppose that \((S, d, \ms S)\) and \((T, e, \ms T)\) are spaces of the type described in .
payload.target_text: Salah satu konsekuensi utama representasi Skorohod, yaitu dipertahankannya konvergensi dalam distribusi oleh fungsi kontinu, tetap berlaku dan pada dasarnya mempunyai bukti yang sama. Untuk kerangka umum, misalkan \((S, d, \ms S)\) dan \((T, e, \ms T)\) adalah ruang-ruang dari jenis yang dijelaskan dalam .

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(X_n\) is a random variable in \(S\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\) (not necessarily defined on the same probability space). Suppose also that \(g: S \to T\) is measurable, and let \(D_g\) denote the set of discontinuities of \(g\), and \(P_\infty\) the distribution of \(X_\infty\). If \(X_n \to X_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution and \(P_\infty(D_g) = 0\), then  \(g(X_n) \to g(X_\infty)\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution.
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(X_n\) adalah peubah acak di \(S\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\) (tidak harus didefinisikan pada ruang probabilitas yang sama). Misalkan pula \(g: S \to T\) terukur, \(D_g\) menyatakan himpunan diskontinuitas \(g\), dan \(P_\infty\) menyatakan distribusi \(X_\infty\). Jika \(X_n \to X_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi dan \(P_\infty(D_g) = 0\), maka  \(g(X_n) \to g(X_\infty)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi.

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text: By Skorohod's theorem, there exists random variables \(Y_n\) in \(S\) for \(n \in \N_+^*\), defined on the same probability space \((\Omega, \ms F, \P)\), such that \(Y_n\) has the same distribution as \(X_n\) for \(n \in \N_+^*\), and \(Y_n \to Y_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) with probability 1. Since \(\P(Y_\infty \in D_g) = P_\infty(D_g) = 0\) it follows that \(g(Y_n) \to g(Y_\infty)\) as \(n \to \infty\) with probability 1. Hence \(g(Y_n) \to g(Y_\infty)\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution. But \(g(Y_n)\) has the same distribution as \(g(X_n)\) for each \(n \in \N_+^*\).
payload.target_text: Menurut teorema Skorohod, terdapat peubah acak \(Y_n\) di \(S\) untuk \(n \in \N_+^*\), semuanya didefinisikan pada ruang probabilitas yang sama \((\Omega, \ms F, \P)\), sedemikian sehingga \(Y_n\) memiliki distribusi yang sama dengan \(X_n\) untuk \(n \in \N_+^*\), dan \(Y_n \to Y_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dengan probabilitas 1. Karena \(\P(Y_\infty \in D_g) = P_\infty(D_g) = 0\), diperoleh \(g(Y_n) \to g(Y_\infty)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dengan probabilitas 1. Oleh karena itu, \(g(Y_n) \to g(Y_\infty)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi. Namun, \(g(Y_n)\) memiliki distribusi yang sama dengan \(g(X_n)\) untuk setiap \(n \in \N_+^*\).

payload.source_text: A simple consequence of the continuity theorem is that if a sequence of random vectors in \(\R^n\) converge in distribution, then the sequence of each coordinate also converges in distribution. Let's just consider the two-dimensional case to keep the notation simple.
payload.target_text: Konsekuensi sederhana dari teorema kekontinuan adalah bahwa jika suatu barisan vektor acak di \(\R^n\) konvergen dalam distribusi, maka barisan pada setiap koordinatnya juga konvergen dalam distribusi. Mari kita tinjau kasus dua dimensi agar notasinya tetap sederhana.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \((X_n, Y_n)\) is a random variable in \(\R^2\) for \(n \in \N_+^*\) and that \((X_n, Y_n) \to (X_\infty, Y_\infty)\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution. Then
payload.target_text: Misalkan \((X_n, Y_n)\) adalah peubah acak di \(\R^2\) untuk \(n \in \N_+^*\), dan \((X_n, Y_n) \to (X_\infty, Y_\infty)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi. Maka

payload.source_text: \(X_n \to X_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution.
payload.target_text: \(X_n \to X_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi.

payload.source_text: \(Y_n \to Y_\infty\) as \(n \to \infty\) in distribution.
payload.target_text: \(Y_n \to Y_\infty\) saat \(n \to \infty\) dalam distribusi.

payload.source_text: Scheffé's Theorem
payload.target_text: Teorema Scheffé

payload.source_text: Our next discussion concerns an important result known as Scheffé's theorem , named after Henry Scheffé . To state our theorem, suppose that \( (S, \ms S, \mu) \) is a measure space, so that \( S \) is a set, \( \ms S \) is a \( \sigma \)-algebra of subsets of \( S \), and \( \mu \) is a positive measure on \( (S, \ms S) \). Further, suppose that \( P_n \) is a probability measure on \( (S, \ms S) \) that has density function \( f_n \) with respect to \( \mu \) for each \( n \in \N_+^* \).
payload.target_text: Pembahasan berikut menyangkut hasil penting yang dikenal sebagai Teorema Scheffé , dinamai menurut Henry Scheffé . Untuk menyatakan teorema ini, misalkan \( (S, \ms S, \mu) \) adalah ruang ukur, sehingga \( S \) adalah suatu himpunan, \( \ms S \) adalah aljabar-\( \sigma \) dari himpunan-himpunan bagian \( S \), dan \( \mu \) adalah ukuran positif pada \( (S, \ms S) \). Selanjutnya, misalkan \( P_n \) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada \( (S, \ms S) \) yang mempunyai fungsi kepadatan \( f_n \) terhadap \( \mu \) untuk setiap \( n \in \N_+^* \).

payload.source_text: If \(f_n(x) \to f_\infty(x)\) as \(n \to \infty\) for almost all \( x \in S \) (with respect to \( \mu \)) then \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) as \(n \to \infty\) uniformly in \(A \in \ms S\).
payload.target_text: Jika \(f_n(x) \to f_\infty(x)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) untuk hampir semua \( x \in S \) (terhadap \( \mu \)), maka \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) secara seragam terhadap \(A \in \ms S\).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text:
From basic properties of the integral it follows that for \( A \in \ms S \),
		\[\left|P_\infty(A) - P_n(A)\right| = \left|\int_A f_\infty \, d\mu - \int_A f_n \, d\mu \right| = \left| \int_A (f_\infty - f_n) \, d\mu\right| \le \int_A \left|f_\infty - f_n\right| \, d\mu \le \int_S \left|f_\infty - f_n\right| \, d\mu\]
		For \(n \in \N_+\) let \(g_n = f_\infty - f_n\), and let \(g_n^+\) denote the positive part of \(g_n\) and \(g_n^-\) the negative part of \(g_n\). Note that \(g_n^+ \le f_\infty\) and \(g_n^+ \to 0\) as \(n \to \infty\) almost everywhere on \( S \). Since \( f_\infty \) is a probability density function, it is trivially integrable, so by the dominated convergence theorem, \(\int_S g_n^+ \, d\mu \to 0\) as \(n \to \infty\). But \(\int_\R g_n \, d\mu = 0\) so \(\int_\R g_n^+ \, d\mu = \int_\R g_n^- \, d\mu\). Therefore \(\int_S \left|g_n\right| \, d\mu = 2 \int_S g_n^+ d\mu \to 0\) as \(n \to \infty\). Hence \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) as \(n \to \infty\) uniformly in \(A \in \ms S\).
payload.target_text:
Dari sifat-sifat dasar integral maka untuk \( A \in \ms S \),
		\[\left|P_\infty(A) - P_n(A)\right| = \left|\int_A f_\infty \, d\mu - \int_A f_n \, d\mu \right| = \left| \int_A (f_\infty - f_n) \, d\mu\right| \le \int_A \left|f_\infty - f_n\right| \, d\mu \le \int_S \left|f_\infty - f_n\right| \, d\mu\]
		Untuk \(n \in \N_+\), misalkan \(g_n = f_\infty - f_n\), dengan \(g_n^+\) menyatakan bagian positif dari \(g_n\) dan \(g_n^-\) bagian negatif dari \(g_n\). Perhatikan bahwa \(g_n^+ \le f_\infty\) dan \(g_n^+ \to 0\) saat \(n \to \infty\) hampir di semua titik pada \( S \). Karena \( f_\infty \) adalah fungsi kepadatan probabilitas, fungsi ini jelas terintegralkan. Jadi, berdasarkan teorema konvergensi terdominasi, \(\int_S g_n^+ \, d\mu \to 0\) saat \(n \to \infty\). Namun, \(\int_\R g_n \, d\mu = 0\), sehingga \(\int_\R g_n^+ \, d\mu = \int_\R g_n^- \, d\mu\). Oleh karena itu, \(\int_S \left|g_n\right| \, d\mu = 2 \int_S g_n^+ d\mu \to 0\) saat \(n \to \infty\). Dengan demikian, \(P_n(A) \to P_\infty(A)\) saat \(n \to \infty\) secara seragam terhadap \(A \in \ms S\).

payload.source_text: Of course, the most important special cases of Scheffé's theorem are to discrete distributions and to continuous distributions on a subset of \( \R^n \), as in on density functions.
payload.target_text: Tentu saja, kasus khusus terpenting dari teorema Scheffé adalah distribusi diskret dan distribusi kontinu pada suatu himpunan bagian \( \R^n \), seperti dalam tentang fungsi kepadatan.

payload.source_text: Expected Value
payload.target_text: Nilai Harapan

payload.source_text: Generating functions are studied in the chapter on expected value . In part, the importance of generating functions stems from the fact that ordinary (pointwise) convergence of a sequence of generating functions corresponds to the convergence of the distributions in the sense of this section. Often it is easier to show convergence in distribution using generating functions than directly from the definition.
payload.target_text: Fungsi pembangkit dipelajari dalam bab tentang nilai harapan . Arti penting fungsi pembangkit sebagian berasal dari fakta bahwa konvergensi biasa (titik demi titik) suatu barisan fungsi pembangkit bersesuaian dengan konvergensi distribusi dalam pengertian bagian ini. Sering kali lebih mudah menunjukkan konvergensi dalam distribusi dengan fungsi pembangkit daripada langsung dari definisinya.

payload.source_text: In addition, converence in distribution has elegant characterizations in terms of the convergence of the expected values of certain types of functions of the underlying random variables.
payload.target_text: Selain itu, konvergensi dalam distribusi mempunyai karakterisasi yang elegan berdasarkan konvergensi nilai harapan dari jenis-jenis fungsi tertentu atas peubah acak yang mendasarinya.

payload.source_text: 10. Conditional Expected Value Revisited
payload.target_text: 10. Nilai Harapan Bersyarat Ditinjau Kembali

payload.source_text: Conditional expected value is much more important than one might at first think. In fact, conditional expected value is at the core of modern probability theory because it provides the basic way of incorporating known information into a probability measure. This section extends our first study of conditional expected value from a more measure-theoretic point of view.
payload.target_text: Nilai harapan bersyarat jauh lebih penting daripada yang mungkin disangka pada awalnya. Bahkan, nilai harapan bersyarat merupakan inti teori probabilitas modern karena menyediakan cara dasar untuk memasukkan informasi yang diketahui ke dalam suatu ukuran probabilitas. Bagian ini memperluas pembahasan pertama kita tentang nilai harapan bersyarat dari sudut pandang yang lebih berlandaskan teori ukuran.

payload.source_text: Basic Theory
payload.target_text: Teori Dasar

payload.source_text: Definition
payload.target_text: Definisi

payload.source_text: As usual, our starting point is a random experiment , as described in random experiment , modeled by a probability space \((\Omega, \mathscr F, \P)\). So \( \Omega \) is the set of outcomes,, \( \mathscr F \) is the \( \sigma \)-algebra of events, and \( \P \) is the probability measure on the sample space \( (\Omega, \mathscr F) \). Previously we studied the conditional expected value of a real-value random variable \(X\) given a  random variable \(Y\). The more general approach is to condition on a sub \(\sigma\)-algebra \( \mathscr G \) of \( \mathscr F \).
payload.target_text: Seperti biasa, titik awal kita adalah suatu eksperimen acak, sebagaimana diuraikan dalam eksperimen acak , yang dimodelkan oleh sebuah ruang probabilitas \((\Omega, \mathscr F, \P)\). Jadi, \( \Omega \) adalah himpunan hasil, \( \mathscr F \) adalah aljabar-\( \sigma \) kejadian, dan \( \P \) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada ruang sampel \( (\Omega, \mathscr F) \). Sebelumnya kita telah mempelajari nilai harapan bersyarat peubah acak bernilai real \(X\) apabila diketahui suatu peubah acak \(Y\). Pendekatan yang lebih umum ialah mengondisikan pada subaljabar-\(\sigma\) \( \mathscr G \) dari \( \mathscr F \).

payload.source_text:
Before we get to the definition, we need some preliminaries. First, all random variables mentioned are assumed to be real valued. Next the notion of an equivalence relation plays a fundamental role in this section. In particular, recall that random variables \( X_1 \) and \( X_2 \) are equivalent if \( \P(X_1 = X_2) = 1 \). Equivalence really does define an equivalence relation on the collection of random variables defined on the sample space. Moreover, we often regard equivalent random variables as being essentially the same object. More precisely from this point of view, the objects of our study are not individual random variables but rather equivalence classes of random variables under this equivalence relation. Finally, for \( A \in \mathscr F \), recall the notation for the expected value of \( X \) on the event \( A \)
\[ \E(X; A) = \E(X \bs{1}_A)\]
assuming of course that the expected value exists. For the remainder of this subsection, suppose that \( \mathscr G \) is a sub \( \sigma \)-algebra of \( \mathscr F \).
payload.target_text:
Sebelum sampai ke definisi, kita memerlukan beberapa hal pendahuluan. Pertama, semua peubah acak yang disebutkan diasumsikan bernilai real. Selanjutnya, gagasan tentang relasi ekuivalensi memainkan peran mendasar dalam bagian ini. Secara khusus, ingat bahwa peubah acak \( X_1 \) dan \( X_2 \) ekuivalen jika \( \P(X_1 = X_2) = 1 \). Ekuivalensi memang mendefinisikan suatu relasi ekuivalensi pada kumpulan peubah acak yang didefinisikan di ruang sampel. Selain itu, kita sering menganggap peubah acak yang ekuivalen sebagai objek yang pada hakikatnya sama. Lebih tepatnya, dari sudut pandang ini objek kajian kita bukanlah peubah acak individual, melainkan kelas-kelas ekuivalensi peubah acak menurut relasi ekuivalensi tersebut. Terakhir, untuk \( A \in \mathscr F \), ingat notasi bagi nilai harapan \( X \) pada kejadian \( A \)
\[ \E(X; A) = \E(X \bs{1}_A)\]
dengan asumsi, tentu saja, bahwa nilai harapan tersebut ada. Sepanjang subbagian ini, anggap bahwa \( \mathscr G \) adalah subaljabar-\( \sigma \) dari \( \mathscr F \).

payload.source_text: Suppose that \(X\) is a random variable with \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \). The conditional expected value of \(X\) given \(\mathscr G\) is the random variable \(\E(X \mid \mathscr G)\) defined by the following properties:
payload.target_text: Misalkan \(X\) adalah peubah acak dengan \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \). Nilai harapan bersyarat \(X\) apabila diketahui \(\mathscr G\) adalah peubah acak \(\E(X \mid \mathscr G)\) yang didefinisikan oleh sifat-sifat berikut:

payload.source_text: \(\E(X \mid \mathscr G)\) is measurable with repsect to \(\mathscr G\).
payload.target_text: \(\E(X \mid \mathscr G)\) terukur terhadap \(\mathscr G\).

payload.source_text: If \(A \in \mathscr G\) then \(\E[\E(X \mid \mathscr G); A] = \E(X; A)\)
payload.target_text: Jika \(A \in \mathscr G\), maka \(\E[\E(X \mid \mathscr G); A] = \E(X; A)\)

payload.source_text: The basic idea is that \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) is the expected value of \( X \) given the information in the \( \sigma \)-algebra \( \mathscr G \). Hopefully this idea will become clearer during our study. The conditions above uniquely define \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) up to equivalence. The proof of this fact is a simple application of the Radon-Nikodym theorem , named for Johann Radon and Otto Nikodym
payload.target_text: Gagasan dasarnya ialah bahwa \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) merupakan nilai harapan \( X \) apabila diketahui informasi dalam aljabar-\( \sigma \) \( \mathscr G \). Semoga gagasan ini akan makin jelas selama pembahasan kita. Syarat-syarat di atas mendefinisikan \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) secara tunggal hingga ekuivalensi. Bukti fakta ini merupakan penerapan sederhana teorema Radon–Nikodym , yang dinamai menurut Johann Radon dan Otto Nikodym

payload.source_text: Suppose again that \(X\) is a random variable with \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \).
payload.target_text: Misalkan lagi bahwa \(X\) adalah peubah acak dengan \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \).

payload.source_text: There exists a random variable \( V \) satisfying definition .
payload.target_text: Ada peubah acak \( V \) yang memenuhi definisi .

payload.source_text: If \( V_1 \) and \( V_2 \) satisfy definition , then \( \P(V_1 = V_2) = 1 \) so that \( V_1 \) and \( V_2 \) are equivalent.
payload.target_text: Jika \( V_1 \) dan \( V_2 \) memenuhi definisi , maka \( \P(V_1 = V_2) = 1 \), sehingga \( V_1 \) dan \( V_2 \) ekuivalen.

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text:
Note that \( 
u(A) = \E(X; A) \) for \( A \in \mathscr G \) defines a (signed) measure on \( \mathscr G \). Moreover, if \( A \in \mathscr G \) and \( \P(A) = 0 \) then \( 
u(A) = 0 \). Hence \( 
u \) is absolutely continuous with respect to the restriction of \( \P \) to \( \mathscr G \). By the Radon-Nikodym theorem, there exists a random variable \( V \) that is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr G \) such that \( 
u(A) = \E(V; A) \) for \( A \in \mathscr G \). That is, \( V \) is the density or derivative of \( 
u \) with respect to \( \P \) on \( \mathscr G \).
payload.target_text:
Perhatikan bahwa \( 
u(A) = \E(X; A) \) untuk \( A \in \mathscr G \) mendefinisikan suatu ukuran (bertanda) pada \( \mathscr G \). Selain itu, jika \( A \in \mathscr G \) dan \( \P(A) = 0 \), maka \( 
u(A) = 0 \). Jadi, \( 
u \) kontinu mutlak terhadap pembatasan \( \P \) pada \( \mathscr G \). Menurut teorema Radon–Nikodym, ada peubah acak \( V \) yang terukur terhadap \( \mathscr G \) sedemikian sehingga \( 
u(A) = \E(V; A) \) untuk \( A \in \mathscr G \). Dengan kata lain, \( V \) adalah kerapatan atau turunan \( 
u \) terhadap \( \P \) pada \( \mathscr G \).

payload.source_text: This follows from the uniqueness of the Radon-Nikodym derivative, up to equivalence.
payload.target_text: Hal ini mengikuti dari ketunggalan turunan Radon–Nikodym, hingga ekuivalensi.

payload.source_text: The following characterization might seem stronger but in fact in equivalent to the definition.
payload.target_text: Karakterisasi berikut mungkin tampak lebih kuat, tetapi sesungguhnya ekuivalen dengan definisi tersebut.

payload.source_text: Suppose again that \(X\) is a random variable with \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \). Then \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) is characterized by the following properties:
payload.target_text: Misalkan lagi bahwa \(X\) adalah peubah acak dengan \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \). Maka \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) dicirikan oleh sifat-sifat berikut:

payload.source_text: \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr G \)
payload.target_text: \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr G \)

payload.source_text: If \( U \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr G \) and \( \E(|U X|) \lt \infty \) then \( \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U X) \).
payload.target_text: Jika \( U \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr G \) dan \( \E(|U X|) \lt \infty \), maka \( \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U X) \).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Detail:

payload.source_text:
We have to show that part (b) in definition is equivalent to part (b) here. First (b) here implies (b) in the definition since \( \bs{1}_A \) is \( \mathscr G \)-measurable if \( A \in \mathscr G \). Conversely suppose that (b) in the definition holds. We will show that (b) here holds by a classical bootstrapping argument. . First \( \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U X) \) if \( U = \bs{1}_A \) for some \( A \in \mathscr G \). Next suppose that \( U \) is a simple random variable that is \( \mathscr G \)-measurable. That is, \( U = \sum_{i \in I} a_i \bs{1}_{A_i} \) where \( I \) is a finite index set, \( a_i \ge 0 \) for \( i \in I \), and \( A_i \in \mathscr G \) for \( i \in I \). then
		\[ \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E\left[\sum_{i \in I} a_i \bs{1}_{A_i} \E(X \mid \mathscr G)\right] = \sum_{i \in I} a_i \E[\bs{1}_{A_i} \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \sum_{i \in I} a_i \E(\bs{1}_{A_i} X) = \E\left(\sum_{i \in I} a_i \bs{1}_{A_i} X\right) = \E(U X)  \]
		Next suppose that \( U \) is nonnegative and \( \mathscr G \)-measurable. Then there exists a sequence of simple \( \mathscr G \)-measurable random variables \( (U_1, U_2, \ldots) \) with \( U_n \uparrow U \) as \( n \to \infty \). Then by the previous step, \( \E[U_n \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U_n X) \) for each \( n \). Letting \( n \to \infty \) and using the monotone convergence theorem we have \( \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U X) \). Finally, suppose that \( U \) is a general \( \mathscr G \)-measurable random variable. Then \( U = U^+ - U^- \) where \( U^+ \) and \( U^- \) are the usual positive and negative parts of \( U \). These parts are nonnegative and \( \mathscr G \)-measurable, so by the previous step, \( \E[U^+ \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U^+ X) \) and \( \E[U^- \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U^- X) \). hence
		\[ \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E[(U^+ - U^-) \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E[U^+ \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] - \E[U^- \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U^+ X) - \E(U^- X) = \E(U X) \]
payload.target_text:
Kita harus menunjukkan bahwa bagian (b) dalam definisi ekuivalen dengan bagian (b) di sini. Pertama, (b) di sini mengakibatkan (b) dalam definisi karena \( \bs{1}_A \) terukur-\( \mathscr G \) jika \( A \in \mathscr G \). Sebaliknya, misalkan (b) dalam definisi berlaku. Kita akan menunjukkan bahwa (b) di sini berlaku melalui argumen bootstrap klasik. Pertama, \( \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U X) \) jika \( U = \bs{1}_A \) untuk suatu \( A \in \mathscr G \). Selanjutnya, misalkan \( U \) adalah peubah acak sederhana yang terukur-\( \mathscr G \). Artinya, \( U = \sum_{i \in I} a_i \bs{1}_{A_i} \), dengan \( I \) himpunan indeks hingga, \( a_i \ge 0 \) untuk \( i \in I \), dan \( A_i \in \mathscr G \) untuk \( i \in I \). Maka
		\[ \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E\left[\sum_{i \in I} a_i \bs{1}_{A_i} \E(X \mid \mathscr G)\right] = \sum_{i \in I} a_i \E[\bs{1}_{A_i} \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \sum_{i \in I} a_i \E(\bs{1}_{A_i} X) = \E\left(\sum_{i \in I} a_i \bs{1}_{A_i} X\right) = \E(U X)  \]
		Selanjutnya, misalkan \( U \) taknegatif dan terukur-\( \mathscr G \). Maka ada barisan peubah acak sederhana terukur-\( \mathscr G \), \( (U_1, U_2, \ldots) \), dengan \( U_n \uparrow U \) ketika \( n \to \infty \). Menurut langkah sebelumnya, \( \E[U_n \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U_n X) \) untuk setiap \( n \). Dengan mengambil \( n \to \infty \) dan menggunakan teorema konvergensi monoton, diperoleh \( \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U X) \). Terakhir, misalkan \( U \) adalah peubah acak terukur-\( \mathscr G \) yang umum. Maka \( U = U^+ - U^- \), dengan \( U^+ \) dan \( U^- \) masing-masing bagian positif dan negatif yang lazim dari \( U \). Bagian-bagian ini taknegatif dan terukur-\( \mathscr G \), sehingga menurut langkah sebelumnya, \( \E[U^+ \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U^+ X) \) dan \( \E[U^- \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U^- X) \). Jadi
		\[ \E[U \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E[(U^+ - U^-) \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E[U^+ \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] - \E[U^- \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] = \E(U^+ X) - \E(U^- X) = \E(U X) \]

payload.source_text: Properties
payload.target_text: Sifat-sifat

payload.source_text: Our next discussion concerns some fundamental properties of conditional expected value.  All equalities and inequalities are understood to hold modulo equivalence , that is, with probability 1. Note also that many of the proofs work by showing that the right hand side satisfies the properties in definition for the conditional expected value on the left side. Once again we assume that \( \mathscr G \) is a sub \( sigma \)-algebra of \( \mathscr F \).

payload.source_text: However, it is not correct to state that \( A \mapsto \P(A \mid \mathscr G) \) is a probability measure, because the conditional probabilities are only defined up to equivalence, and so the mapping does not make sense. We would have to specify a particular version of \( \E(A \mid \mathscr G) \) for each \( A \in \mathscr F \) for the mapping to make sense. Even if we do this, the mapping may not define a probability measure. In part (c), the left and right sides are random variables and the equation is an event that has probability 1. However this event depends on the collection \( \{A_i: i \in I\} \). In general, there will be uncountably many such collections in \( \mathscr F \), and the intersection of all of the corresponding events may well have probability less than 1 (if it's measurable at all). It turns out that if the underlying probability space \( (\Omega, \mathscr F, \P) \) is sufficiently nice (and most probability spaces that arise in applications are nice), then there does in fact exist a regular conditional probability . That is, for each \( A \in \mathscr F \), there exists a random variable \( \P(A \mid \mathscr G) \) satisfying the conditions in and such that with probability 1, \( A \mapsto \P(A \mid \mathscr G) \) is a probability measure.

Bahkan jika hal ini dilakukan, pemetaan tersebut mungkin tidak mendefinisikan ukuran probabilitas. Secara umum, akan ada tak terhitung banyaknya kumpulan seperti itu dalam \( \mathscr F \), dan irisan semua kejadian yang bersesuaian mungkin saja berprobabilitas kurang dari 1 (jika irisan itu terukur). Ternyata, jika ruang probabilitas yang mendasari \( (\Omega, \mathscr F, \P) \) cukup baik (dan kebanyakan ruang probabilitas yang muncul dalam penerapan memang baik), maka benar-benar ada probabilitas bersyarat reguler . payload.source_text:
The purpose of this discussion is to tie the general notions of conditional expected value that we are studying here to the more elementary concepts that you have seen before. Suppose that \( A \) is an event (that is, a member of \( \mathscr F \)) with \( \P(A) \gt 0 \). If \( B \) is another event, then the conditional probability of \( B \) given \( A \) is 
\[ \P(B \mid A) = \frac{\P(A \cap B)}{\P(A)} \]
If \( X \) is a random variable then the conditional distribution of \( X \) given \( A \) is the probability measure on \( \R \) given by
\[ R \mapsto \P(X \in R \mid A) = \frac{\P(\{X \in R\} \cap A)}{\P(A)} \text{ for measurable } R \subseteq \R \]
If \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \) then the conditional expected value of \( X \) given \( A \), denoted \( \E(X \mid A) \), is simply the mean of this conditional distribution.
payload.target_text:
Tujuan pembahasan ini ialah menghubungkan gagasan umum tentang nilai harapan bersyarat yang sedang kita pelajari dengan konsep-konsep lebih elementer yang telah Anda jumpai. Misalkan \( A \) adalah kejadian (yakni anggota \( \mathscr F \)) dengan \( \P(A) \gt 0 \). Jika \( B \) adalah kejadian lain, maka probabilitas bersyarat \( B \) apabila diketahui \( A \) adalah 
\[ \P(B \mid A) = \frac{\P(A \cap B)}{\P(A)} \]
Jika \( X \) adalah peubah acak, maka distribusi bersyarat \( X \) apabila diketahui \( A \) adalah ukuran probabilitas pada \( \R \) yang diberikan oleh
\[ R \mapsto \P(X \in R \mid A) = \frac{\P(\{X \in R\} \cap A)}{\P(A)} \text{ for measurable } R \subseteq \R \]
Jika \( \E(|X|) \lt \infty \), maka nilai harapan bersyarat \( X \) apabila diketahui \( A \), yang dinyatakan dengan \( \E(X \mid A) \), hanyalah rataan distribusi bersyarat ini.

payload.source_text: Suppose now that \( \mathscr{A} = \{A_i: i \in I\} \) is a countable partition of the sample space \( \Omega \) into events with positive probability. To review the jargon, \( \mathscr A \subseteq \mathscr F \); the index set \( I \) is countable; \( A_i \cap A_j = \emptyset \) for distinct \( i, \, j \in I \); \( \bigcup_{i \in I} A_i = \Omega \); and \( \P(A_i) \gt 0 \) for \( i \in I \). Let \( \mathscr G = \sigma(\mathscr{A}) \), the \( \sigma \)-algebra generated by \( \mathscr{A} \). The elements of \( \mathscr G \) are of the form \( \bigcup_{j \in J} A_j \) for \( J \subseteq I \). Moreover, the random variables that are measurable with respect to \( \mathscr G \) are precisely the variables that are constant on \( A_i \) for each \( i \in I \). The \( \sigma \)-algebra \( \mathscr G \) is said to be countably generated .

Untuk mengingat kembali istilahnya, \( \mathscr A \subseteq \mathscr F \); himpunan indeks \( I \) terhitung; \( A_i \cap A_j = \emptyset \) untuk \( i, \, j \in I \) yang berbeda; \( \bigcup_{i \in I} A_i = \Omega \); dan \( \P(A_i) \gt 0 \) untuk \( i \in I \). Misalkan \( \mathscr G = \sigma(\mathscr{A}) \), yakni aljabar-\( \sigma \) yang dibangkitkan oleh \( \mathscr{A} \). Unsur-unsur \( \mathscr G \) berbentuk \( \bigcup_{j \in J} A_j \) untuk \( J \subseteq I \). Selain itu, peubah acak yang terukur terhadap \( \mathscr G \) tepat merupakan peubah yang konstan pada \( A_i \) untuk setiap \( i \in I \). Aljabar-\( \sigma \) \( \mathscr G \) dikatakan dibangkitkan secara terhitung .

\[ \P(A_i \mid B) = \frac{\P(A_i) \P(B \mid A_i)}{\sum_{j \in I} \P(A_j) \P(B \mid A_j)} \]

\[ h(y) = \int_S f(x, y) \, dx, \quad y \in T \]
Assume that \( h(y) \gt 0 \) for \( y \in T \). Then for \( y \in T  \), a conditional probability density function of \( X \) given \( Y = y \) is defined by
\[ g(x \mid y) =\frac{f(x, y)}{h(y)}, \quad x \in S \]

payload.source_text: In our elementary treatment of conditional expected , we showed that the conditional expected value of a real-valued random variable \( X \) given a general random variable \( Y \) is the best predictor of \( X \), in the least squares sense, among all real-valued functions of \( Y \). A more careful statement is that \( \E(X \mid Y) \) is the best predictor of \( X \) among all real-valued random variables that are measurable with respect to \( \sigma(Y) \). Thus, it should come as not surprise that if \( \mathscr G \) is a sub \( \sigma \)-algebra of \( \mathscr F \), then \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) is the best predictor of \( X \), in the least squares sense, among all real-valued random variables that are measurable with respect to \( \mathscr G) \). We will show that this is indeed the case in this subsection. The proofs are very similar to the ones given in the elementary section. For the rest of this discussion, we assume that \( \mathscr G \) is a sub \( \sigma \)-algebra of \( \mathscr F \) and that all random variables mentioned are real valued.
payload.target_text: Dalam pembahasan elementer tentang nilai harapan bersyarat , kita menunjukkan bahwa nilai harapan bersyarat peubah acak bernilai real \( X \) apabila diketahui peubah acak umum \( Y \) adalah prediktor terbaik bagi \( X \), dalam arti kuadrat terkecil, di antara semua fungsi bernilai real dari \( Y \). Pernyataan yang lebih cermat ialah bahwa \( \E(X \mid Y) \) merupakan prediktor terbaik bagi \( X \) di antara semua peubah acak bernilai real yang terukur terhadap \( \sigma(Y) \). Dengan demikian, tidak mengherankan bahwa jika \( \mathscr G \) adalah subaljabar-\( \sigma \) dari \( \mathscr F \), maka \( \E(X \mid \mathscr G) \) merupakan prediktor terbaik bagi \( X \), dalam arti kuadrat terkecil, di antara semua peubah acak bernilai real yang terukur terhadap \( \mathscr G) \). Kita akan menunjukkan bahwa hal ini memang benar dalam subbagian ini. Bukti-buktinya sangat mirip dengan yang diberikan dalam bagian elementer. 	\[ \var(X \mid \mathscr G) = \E\left([X - \E(X \mid \mathscr G)]^2 \biggm| \mathscr G\right) \]

payload.source_text: Like all conditional expected values relative to \( \mathscr G \), \( \var(X \mid \mathscr G) \) is a random variable that is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr G \) and is unique up to equivalence. The first property is analogous to the computational formula for ordinary variance.

payload.source_text: Suppose again that \( \mathscr G \) is a sub \( \sigma \)-algebra of \( \mathscr F \). The conditional covariance of two random variables is defined like the ordinary covariance , but with all expected values conditioned on \( \mathscr G \).
payload.target_text: Misalkan lagi bahwa \( \mathscr G \) adalah subaljabar-\( \sigma \) dari \( \mathscr F \). Kovarians bersyarat dua peubah acak didefinisikan seperti kovarians biasa, tetapi dengan semua nilai harapan dikondisikan pada \( \mathscr G \).

payload.source_text:
Suppose that \( X \) and \( Y \) are random variables with \( \E(X^2) \lt \infty \) and \( \E(Y^2) \lt \infty \). The conditional covariance of \(X\) and \( Y \) given \(\mathscr G\) is defined as
	\[ \cov(X, Y \mid \mathscr G) = \E\left([X - \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] [Y - \E(Y \mid \mathscr G)] \biggm| \mathscr G \right) \]
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \( X \) dan \( Y \) adalah peubah acak dengan \( \E(X^2) \lt \infty \) dan \( \E(Y^2) \lt \infty \). Kovarians bersyarat \(X\) dan \( Y \) apabila diketahui \(\mathscr G\) didefinisikan sebagai
	\[ \cov(X, Y \mid \mathscr G) = \E\left([X - \E(X \mid \mathscr G)] [Y - \E(Y \mid \mathscr G)] \biggm| \mathscr G \right) \]

payload.source_text: So \( \cov(X, Y \mid \mathscr G) \) is a random variable that is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr G \) and is unique up to equivalence. As should be the case, conditional covariance generalizes conditional variance.
payload.target_text: Jadi, \( \cov(X, Y \mid \mathscr G) \) adalah peubah acak yang terukur terhadap \( \mathscr G \) dan tunggal hingga ekuivalensi. Sebagaimana mestinya, kovarians bersyarat menggeneralisasi varians bersyarat.
